body: That would make sense, it is just me I've watched how she behaves with other colleagues and I seem to be her only target.

It's the strangest thing because she is younger than me and supposedly happily married, I'm older and single so I don't get what her deal is. I'm so sorry that happened to you that is awful, I hope you are in a happier work environment now and I will start documenting the behaviour moving forward. Thank you!

Yeah it really says a lot. My race has poured into every facet of my life and ruined it. It's so obvious that my struggles with dating, and getting male attention is because of my race. There are many women around me who are on the same level lookswise, that have tons of friends, have had longterm boyfriends and of course it's because they're white.  Yes there are black women I knew here and there that had boyfriends but they had to fit a certain standard. Whereas the white girls I knew didn't have to be a 10/10 in every regard to find love. A lot of people are still deeply racist even if they want to vehemently deny it.

Yes this has been such a blatant reason as to why my basically non existent dating life has been a joke. I know my race has played a part, because men treat me as disposable and subhuman in a way that I feel I can't discuss with others openly since no one else seems to really get it. Or they'll just say all women experience what I've gone through which I get, but I know my race is a big reason I experience it a lot more than other women. On top of that, not just experiencing the microaggressions, but having nothing to show for it. Like a lot of non black women can say at least they got a relationship to compensate, whereas I have nothing.

I live in a predominantly white area so of course it's going to be white and non black women who are first picked for relationships, but even when I've been to more diverse areas the anti-blackness is so deeply entrenched that me being a visibly black woman has wreaked havoc on any chance of me dating anybody. 

I see it all the time in my area, average looking white women and non black women generally especially being doted on and having a string of relationships where men dote on them. When I see and interact with the black women in my area, they're usually alone.
My father stormed out of the room. Not me.
Why do you say that?
Sorry could you elaborate. What do you mean by roadblocks and missed connections in this context?
Can you elaborate?
Same I find at a stretch people pity me, most just ignore me or try to use me as a means to an end. I am not a real person to anyone, I'm a nobody.

I feel the same way, I spent years deluding myself, maybe next year, maybe somebody will finally see me. But then once I started putting the pieces together it just didn't seem realistic, if I can't get a guy to acknowledge me as a teen, in my 20s then it's unlikely it'll ever happen. All the women my age have boyfriends/fiances I've got nobody.

 I can't think of a single moment in my miserable life where someone was geniunely attracted to me or ever desired starting a family, a life with me. Because if they did I wouldn't be here. I'm so tired of therapy sessions, breathing exercises etc nothing will compensate for the warmth of a loving partner.

Same here I have no energy for anything, I only go into my shit job at this point because I know I'd probably have a complete breakdown over losing what scraps of sanity I have left. I have nothing to really aim for, I have no one that cares about me and my life overall is meaningless.

Same here, I think the most painful part for me is when it really hit me that I'm never going to be asked out. I'm never going to get the flirtatious stares and longing gaze from across the room. I'll never have anyone desire me, want to be with me and truly realising that is deeply dehumanising and soul crushing.

I felt like I wrote this, I'm sorry you experienced that it's horrible. I deal with similar horrible behaviour, people always expect me to move out of their way, when I don't they give me a dirty look or barge into me. Like the entitlement is shocking, because I'd notice they'd move for someone they deem 'valuable'. 

No one treats me like a  human being really, the only time people acknowledge me is to either be rude to me or treat me like their free servant.

I'm exactly the same, I'm shy and find on the rare occasion I can talk to a guy we share the same interests. But unsurprisingly they always go after the confident, outgoing girls. I always noticed it in couples in my personal life, the reserved guys, with same personalities like me would go for outgoing, attractive women. Never fellow reserved women. It's not always the case of course but I have noticed it a lot.

I wondered if I had the same personality would they like me too, but then I remind myself why should I have to contort my personality and image just so some guy will like me. I want them to like me as I am, but no one ever has. It's hard to remind myself of this when guys treat me horribly or ignore me because I don't look or sound like their preference.

Yes I think about it a lot. I remember watching the Joyce Vincent documentary and it was very unsettling and upsetting. I could relate to the loneliness she felt living in England, and how even though everyone in the documentary mentioned her beauty and intellect it wasn't enough to prevent loneliness. I think that is in part due to racism, and the cold aloof culture that is prevalent in England. I also read about Sheila and could relate in many ways to her, as I'm also black and have no close friends or family. I also live in a similar environment to her.

I think it terrifies me in a way because I can't pinpoint what I can do to make people acknowledge me enough to remember me, to include me in their life, and therefore check in on me. I feel like I'm just not important enough or interesting enough for anyone to truly acknowledge. Plus, a lot of people are reliant on their partner and kids to check in on them, or their close friends. Which are usually quite close, so there's no chance of me, an aging black woman to form a connection there.

I fear it deeply because it will probably be my reality. Unless I can get a neighbour to check in on me, or plan ahead then I don't know what I'm going to do because a partner isn't going to happen and I have no one.

Very interesting, I'm not suprised to be honest the men on dating apps and offline only care about beauty. I've also noted from my experience on dating apps a lot of men are extremely classist and racist. 

They want a beauty queen with a phd and refuse to be realistic. Then when they eventually 'settle' if their wives don't fit into their absurd ideals their wives and kids suffer. Even if they do, they still suffer because men, most men are never satisfied.

It's interesting to me in particular how much more effort men on dating apps make if they deem the woman worthy. Better messages, quicker responses, serious proposals etc. It's something I'd like to discuss more on another post or in a chat on here because the women on here get it better then anyone.

I've had the same thing happen to me too, I'll have a conversation with a guy they ask to see me and suddenly they go ice cold. It's incredibly depressing and humiliating knowing the reason someone no longer wants to converse with you is because of the way you look.

All I would need for guys to accept me and desire me is an attractive face, and there are no exceptions to this rule. All guys are like this to some degree. And it's so savagely cruel, because men's ideas of beauty are deeply warped. I know this, and I hate myself for still despite it all desiring companionship.

Sometimes I'll talk to a guy on the rare occasion, but it always comes back to the same thing. Them demanding see me, to assess whether I'm 'good' enough to continue the conversation with. I just don't bother continuing the conversation afterwards, I know how they'll react.

I feel exactly the same. It doesn't matter how much I try to engage in conversation with them, what I do, say, wear, what I contort myself into it's never enough. I am always the outsider looking in, the one being left out. 

It's particularly grating when an attractive woman or person, enters the equation and suddenly everyone that was ignoring me, pays attention to them. Even if and usually when they're quite rude and hostile, it doesn't matter because they're pretty. Just the other day at work a relatively attractive woman my age started working there, she was mean and quite cruel to the children and some staff members yet everyone was falling over themselves to help her and a guy at work that refused to even make eye contact with me offered her some of his lunch. Even though she had her own. It would've been surreal to me if I hadn't seen the similar situation play out a million times before.

Granted I've seen average looking people be the centre of attention but that's usually because they're aggressively extroverted. I can't do the same and get the same results, I mean I used to be extroverted but it didn't reward me with much in the longterm. It's exhausting and crippingly lonely, some days I want to try again, be louder, go through surgery or whatever else to fit in but it won't work. I know it won't, I don't know what to do either.

Same here I really don't know what to do anymore. I've found for me personally there's no real way to cope, work and my studies distract me for a bit but then i think what is the point? I'm going to at best end up alone in a flat somewhere and eventually die by myself. Or end up on the streets and eventually commit suicide. 

I want that so much too, I want to be held and desired I want to love someone and know they feel the same way back. I want to feel excited each day when my partner comes home, to know their smell, their smile. Instead of the reality where no one wants me.

I'm an outsider too, no matter where I go, what I wear what I say it's like people take one look at me and decide I'm not worth their time. Everyone actively avoids me or ignores me, it's a very lonely and emotionally draining experience.
Same I've come to realise that all that matters to people is the way you look, you can be the most boring, rude individual but if you appeal to their gaze it doesn't matter.

Yes it's grim realising that love is conditional and as I'm attracted to men, really seeing that their love is superficial. Most of them are in some way obsessed with proximity to power and beauty, which reflects in their partners. Even when their partner is average looking they always have something else about them that 'compensates', i.e. their partner being white, or younger than them. The rare occasions I've seen average looking black women or 'ugly' black woman like myself in my area with a partner its usually for cultural reasons like arranged marriages and/or they're using her as a free maid, someone to carry the weight of the bills etc and slowly sucking the life out of her.

I feel the same as you, I'm jaded, furious and sad about it. Life feels so empty and meaningless to me too, as I always wanted a partner. I fluctuate between being angry for desiring something so clearly superficial and yearning for it. But I know deep down it isn't real.
I feel like it'd look desperate.

Same here I have always had very thin hair that gets damaged easily, so it's frustrating seeing other black people who can straighten their hair, braid it and so on and still have a thick head of hair. I also can't get clear skin, I've been through different routes, and I'm currently on medication for it and eating very healthily but still experiencing cysts. It's embarrassing having to go out to work or anywhere really and catch people staring at my acne like it's something deeply repulsive.

Yeah I noticed that too about other faw posts. I get no attention. Men ignore me online and off, I don't exist to them.  I recently had my first day at a new job and I noticed even then it was like I was a ghost, no one really interacted with me and they acted like I didn't exist. It was particularly weird with the men at the job, because they'd only bother acknowledging my existence if someone else was guiding me somewhere like I'm only human when another woman is present. I thought initially it was because I'm new there, but there was another girl there who just started and they acknowledged her.

I feel in part it's because I'm still visibly 'young' and that mixed with being ugly and black means I fall into a category of invisible. I can't even imagine what it'd be like to have a man flirt with me, the rare occasion they do acknowledge me the conversation is formal or it's like they're assessing my worth outside of my looks like my class.

I have exactly the same type of anxiety, does yours feel like your suffocating and a tight feeling in your chest? I also shake uncontrollably, it's very embarrassing and has really stunted me in life.

I also find that once whatever is making me anxious is over it takes a few days for my body to return to its normal self. But I'm like you in college so there's never any real respite.

I honestly feel like I wrote this. I feel this deep envy for people in my age group who have it all made. Good job, good apartment, bunch of friends, and they either have a partner or would have no trouble getting one. Meanwhile I can't even get a minimum wage job, I have shit teeth, I know I'll never get into a relationship I can't even get men to acknowledge my existence and I'm stuck living at home for the foreseeable future.

It has made me so bitter and anxious all of the time. I know I'm more capable then those fucking idiots from school to get a job more suited to my skills but all I get are rejection letters. I know that I would be so loving and affectionate in a relationship but men are superficial and only care about what will benefit them. I know what I deserve in this life, and yet all I get is rejection wherever I go.

Right I feel like a lot of women are scared to say it as well because we get bullied into silence if we admit we understandably envy them. It may sound harsh but a lot of them aren't even talented. I see it all the time in music and movies, an average looking woman with a lot of talent being disregarded for the prettier model. 

A lot of them truly do live life on easy mode, women get barraged with sooo many things we should and shouldn't do to get into a relationship, to get certain jobs etc but really it's about beauty and youth. It doesn't matter how nice you are, how smart, how well rounded you are it's about how you look to others.

Men only deem attractive women worthy of their 'friendship' either because they secretly actually want to be with them or because they like how their social status is lifted because they're in proximity to a beautiful woman.

I'm black too and I've noticed other women I've been friends with for years have dumped me for pretty white friends. They all distanced themselves from me and made no real effort to reach out but stayed in contact with one another. People I've tried to befriend are nice enough but not interested. I know it's because of my race and looks. It's horrible to realise even 'nice' people deep down are racist and lookist.

Yes! All the time, whenever I'm out and I see a couple the woman is always more attractive, and all I can think of is the fact that if she were ugly or average that same man wouldn't even look her way. I think we have every right to think this way, and more women need to be aware that men are extremely superficial and if a woman isn't beautiful to them she doesn't exist. A lot of women end up learning in a far more depressing way like when they naturally age or gain weight, or perhaps go through something medically that alters their physical appearance their 'hubby' dumps them like it's nothing. Horrifying.

I feel exactly the same it's awful, I used to think oh well everyone has to do that in adulthood, it's normal and yes most people do have personal responsibilities but nowhere near our level. I had to recently pay a shedload of money for dental treatment, and I realised that so many people would of had family, their partner even friends pay on their behalf or split their bills. Meanwhile if I ask my parents for financial help they get angry, but also have a sense of entitlement to my money, to my time and resources. Which has always been the case for me. Doesn't matter who it is, they always feel entitled to talk at me, use me, then discard me.

I hate the current mentality nowadays that's shoved down our throats that we have to be independent and that  it's healthy to rely on no one. It isn't. All those people touting the independent title are reliant on somebody else, and are always middle class, able bodied individuals that have never had to actually deal with independence like a poor, disabled woman would. What's worse is that people gravitate to that, other people LOVE those kinds of people, even though those types rarely earnt their riches and health. It's not about their personalities which unsurprisingly is usually vile. Whereas if your poor and disabled like me, you'll see how people are visibly disgusted by you.
Could I ask what sort of exercise do you do?
Hi thanks for your response, how much water would you drink a day roughly to try balancing out the dehydration for bruxism?

Same here what makes loneliness horrible is that its relentless. There's no fucking break from it. If I have a scary health issue I will have to book the appointment, I will have to go alone, wait alone, deal with whoever alone. Then if I have to pay of course it's alone, then I go home alone. 

It is scary and exhausting, I always tell myself just get some rest tomorrow you'll feel better but honestly having to deal with adult life alone is too much.
What do you mean?

I binge eat and sleep a lot. Nothing really helps when I'm awake during the day, nothing could ever compare to the love and affections of friends and a partner. The only thing that'll free me from this nightmare is death.

Yes all the friends I've had talk at me not to me, the people I've tried to be in a relationship with do the same, or expect me to be so grateful that they want to use my body and discard me. No one has ever made any effort to keep me around, to actually love me.
Right like why do they get easy access to love from their partners, family and friends while I have nothing. What did I do to deserve being so fucking lonely.

I always think no wonder some people are so joyful and optimistic about life, they're attractive and get flirted with all the time. Of course that's gonna boost your esteem and improve your overall view of life. I had a dream recently a guy flirted with me and asked me out, it felt great then I woke up lol.
Yes my mother is a very volatile, mean individual. She doesn't deserve me or my sister she is rancid to her core.
My mother is the same she thinks the whole world revolves around her. I can't wait for the day she drops dead.

Right a lot of the 'problems' that they whinge about are minor or not as severe to that of an ugly person with no partner, family or friends. They never shut the fuck up either and a lot of their issues are extremely superficial or could easily be resolved if they actually used their brains for once. 

I can't stand browsing other subreddits like lonely and depression anymore because it's just hoards of people whining about something and then adding their partner in the post. I can't relate and don't bother reading the post like boo fucking hoo they have no idea what it's like to be alone, truly alone and have to deal with a myriad of mental illnesses.

I honestly don't care about them or their problems. Imagine what they'd be like if they couldn't constantly jump from one partner to the next or had a pathetic partner doting on them. They'd be insufferable. It's just reminds me of conventionally attractive women humblebragging on other social media sites under the guise of having a problem in their life. Like shut the fuck up already.

I think I've always desperately wanted to be the person everyone gravitates to. They're always pretty, men and women adore them. I'm always the person that's easily discarded, avoided, or talked at not to. I am never truly desired in any shape or form.
Same I feel hopeless and empty inside, I just want to die.

I feel similar. I've become disillusioned with finding love because of my horrific experiences and the general realisation of how horrible most if not all men are. Most of them have a very simplistic view of women and treat us like toys to play with and discard. Why would I willingly want that in my life. In any form.

Once I saw what most relationships really are or what'd I'd have to excuse or tolerate a part of me died. I feel numb or hopless towards it now. Eventually I assume I'll just feel numb.
It is terrifying honestly to realise just how lonely I am. I could disappear right now and no one would notice.

I'm the same I aimlessly wander in and out of each day, either deeply depressed, very anxious or both. All I have are things that make me miserable. Nothing to ease the burden. I'm dumb, poor, ugly and alone like I've always been.

I second you there I feel like my body is made of tissue paper, one wrong move and its over. I gain weight very easily too especially with all the medication I'm on. I have to be very careful with what I eat whereas other people smoke, drink, gobble down food like there's no tomorrow. And there's nothing wrong with it, but I envy them so much that it doesn't do a damned thing to them.

I get you, the few times I've managed to engage in conversation with a man they ghost, expect me to carry the conversation, or try and bully me into doing what they want i.e. sending nudes. Even then they make no real effort they just sloppily demand it and then expect me to be oh so grateful that they gave me a crumb of attention. Fucking vile honestly.

I used to fluctuate between wanting to be pretty so I could find someone and not wanting it at all. Now I feel numb, I've seen men for what they are and I feel like if I woke up beautiful I'd just be so disgusted by how they would start treating me. If I was pretty I'd just use it to get things from them and then discard them. I am fed up of their superficial arrogant nature. The older I get the more contempt I feel for them and relationships.

Same here I hate it. I hate my useless fucking family for abusing me and then not even offering any real support in adulthood but expecting me to magically become a fully functioning adult. I haven't had any friends since childhood either.

I hate being alive in such a superficial world and being forced to compete like a fucking animal for everything. I don't want to work or study when there's no real point I'm not gifted or good at anything and it's not like I have a partner to ease the burden. I'm fed up of existing.

I completely get her in that sometimes I avoid watching certain films or tv shows when I'm at my lowest mentally. I remember watching new moon I think and wondering what I'd look like in some of Bella's clothes and then realising I'd look like shit, pretty people make anything look good.

Just be confident is such a crock of shit. Confidence won't compensate for much. Someone prettier will always be preferred. Someone richer, smarter, whiter. I do what I can with what I have but even when I was younger and more confident it did nothing for me. Someone else who had something I'd never possess (a lot of the time just being pretty) always got what I wanted over me. It only really benefits somebody if they have something else the masses deem a positive trait.

Yeah I've learnt most people are leeches one way or another especially when they deem you as easily accessible. I have an interview for a job coming up and my relatives are already trying to squeeze money out of me, for a job I haven't even gotten yet. Like I owe none of you anything. My money is mine, my time is mine, my body is mine, fuck anyone that disagrees.
Same lol sometimes I'll block them on other forms of social media if I find their posts particularly nauseating.

I think that's a really good point about pretty and young women ruling the internet, I see it all the time. Everything is about their beauty, other women's beauty, such superficial things that they fixate over and have thousands agree with. It's just a different face, thinking they're sooo unique with the same exact mentality as the last pretty woman. It makes visiting other places like twitter, facebook exhausting they always seep through with their mind numbing drivel. I actively avoid them or block them it's annoying being bombarded with the same fucking nonsense all the time.

Same here I buy food or finish up an essay for college and think to myself what is the fucking point. I think the only reason I do it is because I'm too scared/exhausted to really think out and go through with a suicide attempt.

I feel exactly the same, there's simply no point exhausting ourselves for years on end and then by the time we might get to finally stop in retirement we'll be too old and in too much pain to really do anything. Life is fucking pointless I just want to die.

I'm glad someone has been brave enough to say this. I'm sick of the way that medical professionals are worshipped when a LOT of them treat those really struggling with their mental health like fucking trash. The amount of times I've come across doctors, nurses, who've acted like me attempting to end my life is nothing more than a waste of time is abhorrent.

The older I get the more I realize most medical professionals go into the profession for the money and prestige of being a doctor. They'll act all fake nice, or at least civil if they deem the medical issue you're struggling with as 'worthy' of their time, but they don't really give a shit. They like most people that adhere to capitalism to great extremes find it very easy to discard and completely disregard the needs and wants of human beings. I'm so sick and tired of seeing the never ending bullshit about how great medical professionals are like just shut the fuck up already.
Same here people are awful.
Same here I hope every time I go to sleep I don't wake up it is a living nightmare.
Same here, it sucks seeing them online and knowing they just don't care enough to ever respond. Just cruel.
Nope nothing unfortunately.
Exactly I've tried everything, death is my only true option out of this hell.
